method: The pinned generic GGML CPU executed MUL_MAT and MUL_MAT_ID with F32/F32, F16/F32, BF16/F32 and BF16/BF16 storage. The original ggml_set_f32_1d writes the input rows. Indexed products select experts 1 then 0, with opposite weight signs. Two columns distinguish a rounded F32 product from an exact product and ordered F64 accumulation from an exact reduction. A separate lane yields +4 for expert zero and -4 for expert one.
comparison: Bit identity across all six output words in each graph. Check scheduler placement before allocation.
build: The unmodified pinned CPU was compiled by the repository conformance recipe with GGML_CPU_GENERIC, -ffp-contract=off and one worker.
